Second-Device Architecture

How Kavach Protects Your Parents

Zero network taps. Zero carrier interception. Kavach operates over room speakerphone, analyzing conversation patterns and alerting family before money is transferred.

01

The Call Begins on Speakerphone

When an unfamiliar number or robocall rings, the elder answers on speakerphone. Kavach sits on a secondary device (an old tablet or phone kept on the tabletop). The elder taps “Start” or leaves hands-free mode active.

Acoustic room capture at 16 kHz PCM · Silence gated (zero credits burned when quiet)
02

Deterministic 5-Stage Pattern Detection

As the scammer delivers their interrogation script, our sub-millisecond offline engine tracks psychological stages:

S1 AuthorityS2 AccusationS3 IsolationS4 UrgencyS5 Payment

Adversarial benign filtering prevents legitimate bank notifications or doctor reminders from firing false alarms.

03

Stage 3 Isolation Triggers Immediate Caregiver Alert

The moment the caller says “Do not tell your family, stay on video, this is a confidential CBI enquiry”, Kavach escalates to Level 2 (Caution). An instant Telegram push notification with a 1-click action link is dispatched to family caregivers.

Level 2: Caution

04

Intervention & Emergency Voice Break

The caregiver can hold the live Push-to-Talk button from their smartphone anywhere in the world to speak out of the elder's speaker. If the caregiver cannot connect within 20 seconds of an escalation, Kavach speaks a pre-rendered alert in the son or daughter's consented voice:

“Mummy, yeh scam call hai! Phone kaat do! Main ghar aa raha hoon.”
